_comment: NEPTR default patch map (docs/NEPTR_POOL_BENCH.md). Installed as ~/demiurge/patches/<patch>.map.json for every NEPTR patch.
It reproduces TODAY's non-encoder control behaviour exactly, through the pool:
1. DUODECIMUS treadle  ->  the ONE expression pedal (ch1 CC29 /cc into csound, soft takeover and gkLastToggle29 routing stay in the engine).
Source /hw/midi/1/29 is the LOGICAL pedal: demiurge-io --midi --midi-neptr rewrites ch7 CC14/15 -> ch1 CC29 and parks the body's own ch1 CC29 (same as midi_handler.orc).
2. Arcade button b1    ->  tempo TAP to demiurge-clock (what serial_bridge.py did as ch16 CC113). 'arcade':'tap' = only while no USS instrument owns the button.
Deliberately NOT mapped (so nothing new reaches csound, exactly as today): joystick x/y/click, LiDAR 1/2, FSR 1/2, accel, mics, the onboard exp pedal, buttons b2-b9.
They are pool sources (/hw/teensy/<id>) ready for learn, the web UI or a USS hard map. Encoders and encoder buttons stay on MIDI with fixed menu roles.
